The 'הבטחת קרן' note in brackets is hard to follow
Didn't understand what 'העוגן' means in the anchor-rate line
Unclear why age matters and which rules change at which age
The money-market fund the page recommends is not explained
Codes like TXI-03, BANK-06 and BANK-23 mean nothing to the reader
'חשבון במערכת סגורה' sounds too technical
The 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' withdrawal card says too little
The red early-breaking warning ends with 'שאלה פתוחה', which worries more than it helps
Only half understood the part about the Governor appointing a manager
Screens didn't join up, so some sentences may have been missed
The chart has a second thin line with no visible legend
Wanted the nominal (bank-statement) final amount shown next to the today's-money figure

Didn't understand 'ריבית הפריים' or how it affects their interest
Unclear whether the 'צמוד פריים' tax note matters to them
The securities-loss offset sentence assumes knowledge the reader doesn't have

Important auto-renewal information is buried at the bottom of the table
No side-by-side comparison of current rates across banks and terms
No plain explanation of what to do if the money is needed in an emergency
Unclear whether the reader personally qualifies for the tax exemption
No context on what happened to depositors when banks got into trouble

problems.why: The report never mentions a repeated show/hide rules button or one that does nothing when pressed; it only mentions an empty rules column in the cost table and the age-rules question, which are about other things.
